crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
For Herod had arrested John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

translations.web: “ ‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.
translations.bsb: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.
translations.kjv: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
translations.asv: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
